assertions: Every SRS method/path has an operation, valid schema and existing owner task
OpenAPI matches authoring source; all request/query/path/header/response schemas compile in strict mode
Unknown/protected fields, wrong types, Unicode storage limits, dates, enums and pagination are rejected
PATCH merged-state validation requires authorized current task state; version fields are explicit
Board same-column versions and self-anchor rules are checked before database operations
Query decoding rejects inherited-property names, repeated scalars and ambiguous encodings
Response DTOs exclude private fields; error/requestId/no-store/idempotency declarations are consistent
Nested member/subtask/display DTOs and board fallback schemas support existing screens
notProven: SQLite or SQL Server database constraints/transactions
